title: Chordal and Conference Cubics: Reconstruction and a Residual C2-Torsor
description: Two geometrically inequivalent A5-invariant cubic shadows occur on the same five-dimensional quadratic augmentation module: chordal cubics and conference cubics. The singular quartic of a chordal cubic and its split twelve-point A5/C5 orbit recover the six-axis carrier A5/D10. After one chordal line is selected, the normalized outer action gives a reversible correspondence with the oriented conference companion; without that selection the correspondence is exactly a residual C2-quotient. A separate integral theorem identifies the resulting marking with Frobenius on the common binary heart.
